newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam to sell 50 bln dong T-notes on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam to sell 50 bln dong T-notes on Wednesday.

text.p: Vietnam will auction 50 billion dong ($4.29 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said on Tuesday.
At the last sale of government paper, on April 2, the central bank sold one billion dong worth of one-year Treasury notes to one domestic institution at an annual interest rate of 12.00 percent.
The government has held six Treasury paper auctions so far this year, through which a total of 179.4 billion dong worth of Treasury stock has been issued. (US$1=11,655 dong)
